title: McMoneagle's CIA remote viewing of Mars a million years ago

tellings.quote: who was tasked by the CIA to remote view Mars a million years ago and described giant beings.

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle was, according to Michels, tasked by the CIA to remote view Mars as it was a million years ago, remote viewing being the claimed skill of describing faraway places or times with the mind alone, and he described giant beings there. Michels brings this up himself, mentioning that McMoneagle told it on the show of a podcaster named Shawn Ryan, in an episode about claims of giants.
